final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON f.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.bats), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts), shares AS (SELECT h.batting_hand, h.record_count, 1.0 * h.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM shares) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.record_count, s.share, s.record_count - a.mean_count FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND s.record_count > a.mean_count
